job: Show the brand, the main links and the sign-up action at the top of every public page.
purpose: A sticky bar: brand, links and actions. It is transparent at the top and takes the page colour, a blur and a hairline once the page scrolls (data-scrolled, from site.js). Below desktop the links move into a full-width sheet opened by a menu button; Escape closes it and returns focus. A link may open an fd-menu; an fd-banner may sit above it.

avoidWhen.when: The top bar of a signed-in app.
The top bar of a docs site.

states.name: open
states.how: data-state="open" on the header and data-open on the nav (the sheet below desktop)

variants.useWhen: The links follow the brand; the actions sit at the end.
Few links, set in the middle between brand and actions.

parts.role: The links; the sheet below desktop.
The list of links; an li with data-sheet shows only in the sheet.
A link, or a button that opens an fd-menu.
Sign in and the primary action.

keyboard.does: On the menu button: opens or closes the sheet.
Closes the sheet and returns focus to the menu button.
